title: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: rocking-bag CAR-T expansion process (not a real publication)
license: Synthetic test fixture written for BioSense-AI. Not biological evidence and not clinical or manufacturing guidance.

paragraphs.text: SYNTHETIC. Donor T cells (line SYNTH-D01) were seeded at 1.0 x 10^6 cells/mL in a 100 mL rocking bag and stimulated with anti-CD3/CD28 reagent at a bead-to-cell ratio of 1 for 48 h.
SYNTHETIC. Cultures received IL-2 at 100 IU/mL from the start of activation and maintained to harvest, with half-volume medium addition once the density approached the bag limit.
SYNTHETIC. Lentiviral vector was added on day 2 at a multiplicity of infection of 1.
SYNTHETIC. Expansion continued for 7 days after transduction and the product was harvested on day 10.
SYNTHETIC. Replacing IL-2 with IL-7 at 10 ng/mL together with IL-15 at 5 ng/mL increased total expansion 1.7-fold by day 10 in the same bag format.
SYNTHETIC. EXH1-knockout T cells expanded poorly under the standard schedule and required a shortened activation of 24 h together with IL-15 raised to 15 ng/mL to match unedited cells.
